Markets.title: India 10-year yield hits over two-year high as supply angst adds to global woes
Markets.summary: Indian government bond yields reached a two-year high due to heavy government borrowing plans and a shift toward longer-dated bonds. This domestic supply pressure was compounded by rising global yields, surging crude oil prices, and fears of looming interest rate hikes.

Markets.title: AceVector IPO, 2 other mainboard offers see strong demand on Day 2. Check GMP, subscription status
Markets.summary: On their second bidding day, the mainboard IPOs of AceVector, Runwal Enterprises, and German Green Steel & Power attracted strong investor interest, with German Green Steel leading at 3.14 times subscription. Additionally, 20 more IPOs aiming to raise a combined Rs 1,292 crore are scheduled to launch next week.

Markets.title: Global Market: BOJ policymakers see case for faster rate hikes as inflation risks mount
Markets.summary: Bank of Japan policymakers are considering faster interest rate hikes because inflation risks are mounting. Officials warn that delaying these rate adjustments could harm the economy.

Markets.title: Rupee pinned just shy of 96/USD as RBI intervention counters oil woes
Markets.summary: Rising oil prices caused by Middle East tensions pushed the Indian rupee down near 96 per dollar. The Reserve Bank of India intervened by using its foreign exchange reserves to prevent the currency from falling further.

Markets.title: IPO allotments today: How to check allotment status for Elevate Campuses, Swastika Infra & ArMee Infotech on NSE, BSE & registrars?
Markets.summary: IPO share allotments for Elevate Campuses, Swastika Infra, and ArMee Infotech are expected today, September 28. Investors can check their allotment status on the BSE, NSE, and registrar websites before the stocks list on September 30.

Markets.title: Global Market: DayOne pushes ahead with potential November IPO amid data center scrutiny
Markets.summary: Data center operator DayOne is preparing for a potential U.S. IPO in November, targeting a valuation near $20 billion. The company plans to file with the SEC in October as investors increasingly scrutinize AI infrastructure, financing costs, and contracted revenues.

Geo-Political.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
Geo-Political.summary: The BBC gained rare access to a front-line conflict zone in Yemen. Journalists traveled alongside pro-government soldiers as they battled Houthi forces for control of the city.

Geo-Political.title: Embattled Serbian president resigns, paving way for early elections
Geo-Political.summary: Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić has resigned following months of prolonged protests over government corruption allegations. His departure has paved the way for early elections in the country.

Geo-Political.title: Two bodies found after avalanche hits Himalayan climbing group
Geo-Political.summary: Rescuers found two bodies after an avalanche struck a climbing group preparing for the Himlung Himal peak in the Himalayas. They are currently searching for at least 10 missing Nepalese guides and staff.

Geo-Political.title: Two mass shootings in South Africa leave 28 dead
Geo-Political.summary: Two separate mass shootings in South Africa left 28 people dead within hours of each other. The attacks highlight the country's ongoing struggle with high levels of gang-related armed violence.

Geo-Political.summary: Four people died in a helicopter crash near Montreal. Quebec provincial police have not yet identified the victims.

Geo-Political.summary: Venezuela released dozens of political dissidents from long-term detention. This action occurred days after the nation's interim leader met with the US president.

Data & Insights.title: How gold sector is gearing up $100 bn export target as India eyes massive expansion in $55 bn FTA jewellery market
Data & Insights.summary: India's World Gold Council expects domestic mines to supply 20 to 25 percent of the country's gold consumption over the next five to seven years. Additionally, the gold sector aims to increase jewellery exports to $100 billion by tapping into the $55 billion Free Trade Agreement market.

Data & Insights.title: Mounting govt debt and AI capex: what higher interest rates mean for India
Data & Insights.summary: Global government debt and massive corporate investments in AI are driving interest rates higher worldwide. These sustained high rates will create significant economic implications for emerging markets like India.

Data & Insights.title: Buying an AC, TV, and refrigerator this festive season? Prices to increase up to 8% from Oct 1
Data & Insights.summary: Leading consumer electronics makers are raising appliance prices by 5% to 8% starting October 1. The price increases will affect air conditioners, LED TVs, and washing machines ahead of the peak festival season.

Data & Insights.title: Sitharaman on India’s 10%+ growth potential: Startups and technology can drive next phase
Data & Insights.summary: Finance Minister Sitharaman stated that startups and technology can help India achieve over 10% economic growth. She emphasized that reaching this higher growth level to support national development goals will require significant effort from all sectors of society.

Data & Insights.title: India's forex fall by $14.9 billion in a week, says RBI: Where do reserves stand now?
Data & Insights.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves dropped by $14.9 billion in a single week, according to the Reserve Bank of India. The decline was primarily driven by a reduction in foreign currency assets, which make up the largest component of the country's reserves.

Data & Insights.title: India's financial, external sectors remain resilient despite global risks: RBI bulletin
Data & Insights.summary: According to the RBI Bulletin, India's financial and external sectors remain resilient despite ongoing global risks. This economic strength is supported by strong Q1 growth, a five-year high in net FDI, robust exports and remittances, and $765.9 billion in forex reserves.

India.title: "Power That No Longer Fears Voters": Rahul Gandhi On Delhi Minister's Slap Row
India.summary: Congress leader Rahul Gandhi criticized BJP leaders after a Delhi minister was slapped during a public event. He claimed that this arrogance stems from alleged vote theft, which makes leaders feel unaccountable to voters.

India.title: Madhya Pradesh Influencer Nidhi Tiwari With 16 Lakh Followers Dies By Suicide
India.summary: Madhya Pradesh social media influencer Nidhi Tiwari, who had 1.6 million followers, died by suicide on Saturday evening. Her family stated that she was speaking to someone on the phone at the time of her death.

India.title: NDTV Yuva 2026 Live Updates: Changemakers, Creators And Leaders Gather At NDTV Yuva
India.summary: Changemakers, creators, and leaders have gathered in India for the NDTV Yuva 2026 event. The conference aims to provide a platform for young Indians to engage with each other, exchange ideas, and foster empowerment.

India.title: 'Distress Call, Then Men Answered Phone': Father Of Assam Student Found Dead
India.summary: An Assam student was found dead after making a distress call, and her father stated that men answered her phone. The father suspects his daughter was assaulted and killed by multiple people.

India.title: "Keep Quiet Or...": Pune Fort Murder Witness Was 'Threatened' By Accused Chetan
India.summary: An eyewitness to the Pune Fort murder delayed giving a statement for five days because the accused, Chetan, had threatened them. Terrified by the warning to keep quiet, the witness eventually came forward to record their account.

India.title: "Painful Parallels To Nirbhaya Case": Supreme Court On Delhi-NCR Rape Cases
India.summary: The Supreme Court took suo motu cognizance of recent rape cases in the Delhi-NCR region, comparing them to the 2012 Nirbhaya case. Justice JB Pardiwala stated that these incidents clearly highlight the failure of law enforcement agencies.

General.title: What we know about RAF Fairford counter-terror probe
General.summary: Counter-terrorism police have arrested five men following a major incident near RAF Fairford. Authorities are currently leading an investigation into the suspects and the circumstances surrounding the airbase.

General.title: Police block Protestant Orange Order from controversial parade route
General.summary: Police blocked the Protestant Orange Order from marching down a controversial route on the Garvaghy Road. The group had failed to complete their permitted Sunday morning parade because nationalist protesters had gathered there.

General.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
General.summary: The BBC gained rare access to Yemen's conflict zone to travel with pro-government soldiers. They reported from the front line where forces are battling the Houthis for control of the city.

General.summary: A BBC reporting team gained rare access to the front line of Yemen's conflict alongside pro-government soldiers. During the visit, the journalists had to take cover after a Houthi drone was spotted overhead.

General.title: Thousands of illegal ghost plates on cars revealed by new cameras
General.summary: New cameras have revealed thousands of illegal ghost plates on vehicles across the UK. The BBC learned that these hard-to-track registration plates are easily obtained and put the public at risk.

General.title: My hometown shows that high streets have to change or die
General.summary: Aberdeen is launching a major initiative to revive its struggling city center. This effort aims to provide lessons and strategies for revitalizing failing high streets elsewhere.
